senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; ירע to shake, tent-cloth, curtain. Ohol. VIII, 1; a. fr.—Pl. יְרִיעוֹת. Ib. XV, 4 בית שחצצו או בי׳ … a room which has been divided off by boards or curtains. Tanḥ. T’rumah 9.
units: Ex. R. s. 50; a. fr.—Trnsf. a writing sheet containing several columns of writing and being part of a scroll.
<cite ref="Tractate Soferim 2:6">Treat. Sof’rim II, 6</cite> <he>אין פוחתין בי׳ וכ׳</he> a sheet of a Torah scroll must have no less than three and no more than eight columns.
<cite ref="Tractate Soferim 2:5">Ib. 5</cite> <he>עושה אותו י׳ קטנה</he> he may have for that column a special small sheet.
Tosef. Sabb. VIII (IX), 13; a. fr.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Shabbat 11a:5">Sabb. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>אם … ושמים י׳ וכ׳</he> if all waters were ink …, and the heavens sheets &c., v. <cite ref="H01078"><he>חָלָל</he> III</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Yadayim 2:10">Tosef. Yad. II, 10</cite>; a. fr.
